vectors.name: uid_7ff0_12345678
vectors.description: DUB response for 7FF0:12345678: 7x FE, AA, 12 encoded UID bytes (b|AA, b|55), 4 encoded checksum bytes
vectors.source: E1.20 §7.5.1 (encoding as in tube_fw rdm.c send_dub_response and OLA DiscoveryAgent::BranchComplete)
vectors.hex: FE FE FE FE FE FE FE AA FF 7F FA F5 BA 57 BE 75 FE 57 FA 7D AA 5D FF 7D
vectors.notes: No start code, no break. Checksum = sum of the 12 EUID bytes = sum(UID)+6*0xFF.

vectors.name: uid_7ff0_12345678_no_preamble
vectors.description: Same response with 0 preamble bytes (controller must accept 0..7 x FE before AA)
vectors.hex: AA FF 7F FA F5 BA 57 BE 75 FE 57 FA 7D AA 5D FF 7D

vectors.name: collision_garbled
vectors.description: Encoded UID byte damaged (as by a collision) -> checksum mismatch -> treat as collision, split range
vectors.hex: FE FE FE FE FE FE FE AA FE 7F FA F5 BA 57 BE 75 FE 57 FA 7D AA 5D FF 7D
